description: Baseline benchmark setup crashed during self startup subprocess

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline for usecli startup/config/command discovery including self and dependency scenarios.
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark script failed before baseline due to subprocess error; need inspect stderr and adjust benchmark setup rather than code optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Run the self_code subprocess manually with stderr visible; likely Python 3.14/Typer compatibility or dependency mismatch in local environment.

description: Baseline benchmark after using project uv environment for dependencies

asi.hypothesis: Measure representative CLI startup with dependencies available via uv run; this establishes baseline for config and command discovery speed.
asi.benchmark_note: Previous crash was benchmark environment only: plain python lacked simple-term-menu; measure.sh now launches outer harness through uv run python.

description: Lazy console-script alias discovery during config matching

asi.hypothesis: Avoid importlib.metadata.distributions() on the common path where config command_name exactly matches argv[0]; only compute aliases for mismatched configs that might be valid aliases.
asi.result: Small improvement across all startup scenarios; preserves alias behavior by lazily falling back to metadata lookup only when needed.

description: Cache get_config by unchanged cwd to avoid repeated root detection

asi.hypothesis: Repeated get_config calls during one process can skip find_project_root when cwd is unchanged.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms was slightly worse than best despite large self_ms improvement; dependency/config medians dominate the primary benchmark and did not improve.
asi.next_action_hint: Reconsider with a primary metric that weights self startup, or combine this cache with changes that reduce dependency/config paths before retesting.

description: Iterate module __dict__ instead of inspect.getmembers for command class discovery

asi.hypothesis: Avoid sorting and tuple creation from inspect.getmembers while loading many command modules.
asi.rollback_reason: Focused tests patch inspect.getmembers with MagicMock modules; direct __dict__ iteration encountered MagicMock sentinel values and failed test assumptions. Primary also did not improve.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisiting, guard with `vars(module)` only for real ModuleType and fallback to inspect.getmembers for non-module mocks, or update tests intentionally if behavior change is desired.

description: Fast __dict__ command member iteration for real modules with test fallback

asi.hypothesis: Use module.__dict__.values for real imported command modules to avoid inspect.getmembers sorting overhead, while retaining inspect fallback for mocked tests.
asi.rollback_reason: Checks passed but primary startup_ms regressed; overhead is not important relative to subprocess/import/config costs or variance.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on config discovery/import-time dependency costs instead of command class member enumeration.

description: Cache parsed pyproject data inside ConfigManager

asi.hypothesis: Avoid parsing pyproject.toml twice during startup for version and direct-dependency checks.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed; pyproject parsing is not a measurable bottleneck in this workload or added method overhead offsets savings.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for import-time heavy modules or avoid unnecessary recursive config scans rather than pyproject parse caching.

description: Lazy usecli.cli.core package exports to reduce eager Rich/validator imports

asi.hypothesis: Parent package usecli.cli.core is imported before base_command, so removing eager imports of error handlers, validators, and UI aliases should reduce startup import cost.
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark crashed during self startup; stderr not included in benchmark output, so the compatibility issue needs manual reproduction after revert if revisited.
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply cautiously and run `PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -c 'import sys; sys.argv=["usecli"]; import usecli'` with stderr visible. Likely some code imports deprecated aliases such as usecli.cli.core.ui/list/title through package init.

description: Lazy import terminal_menu inside Menu methods

asi.hypothesis: Avoid importing simple-term-menu during normal CLI startup unless Menu is actually used interactively.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed; simple-term-menu import is not dominant in current uv environment or saved work is hidden by other import costs/noise.
asi.next_action_hint: Larger import-time wins likely require reducing core package/Rich/Jinja imports or avoiding loading hidden init/make commands, not just menu utility laziness.

description: Skip usecli-only init command import for downstream CLIs

asi.hypothesis: Downstream CLIs should not import/register `init_command.py`, which is only visible for the `usecli` executable and pulls heavy scaffolding dependencies like Jinja/Rich prompts/pyfiglet.
asi.result: Substantial dependency startup win while preserving self usecli behavior and focused tests; avoids loading a hidden command instead of changing discovery semantics.

description: Skip usecli-only make command modules for downstream CLIs

asi.hypothesis: `make:command` and `make:theme` are visible only for the `usecli` executable but are still imported by downstream CLIs, pulling Jinja/caseconverter/Rich scaffolding dependencies.
asi.result: Large dependency/config startup improvement by avoiding hidden usecli-only command module imports for non-usecli argv[0]; self usecli still loads them.

description: Hoist usecli-only command-name check out of command file loop

asi.hypothesis: Avoid recomputing Path(sys.argv[0]).name for every discovered command file.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed versus best; micro-optimization is lost in noise and may not affect real file/import bottlenecks.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on reducing modules imported, not per-file condition overhead.

description: Avoid eager inspect import and use direct class checks for real command modules

asi.hypothesis: Real imported command modules can be scanned via their __dict__ with isinstance(obj, type), avoiding eager inspect import and inspect.getmembers sorting; keep inspect only for test/mock fallback.
asi.result: Small primary improvement driven by dependency/config path; self usecli startup worsened slightly, so monitor future changes.
